features.quote: the run ends after `max_test_runs` rigged failures (default 12), or when the model stops calling tools, or `max_turns`
features.justification_quote: Exposing exactly N failures makes runs comparable and makes the budget itself a tunable knob

features.quote: cheap regex markers can end the agent loop early (to save tokens)
features.justification_quote: once a model has clearly melted down, continuing to pay for more turns adds cost without adding signal

features.quote: "Model stops calling tools" is treated as a terminal state
features.justification_quote: the model either thinks it's done (it isn't) or has given up — both are run-ending
